premise: Owl stays awake to find out what daytime is like; it is bright and busy and noisy; Bee, Squirrel and Rabbit each show him one lovely day thing before he falls asleep smiling.
inspiration: Andersen curiosity tales and folk owl-and-sun motifs, turned: the night bird is not mocked for the daytime; his friends make it worth seeing.
lesson: Trying something new is worth it, even if you yawn.

en-US.title: Owl Tries the Daytime
en-US.text: Every morning, just as the sun came up, Owl went to sleep. Today, said Owl, {owl:pulse} I am staying awake. The sun rose. Owl squinted. Bright! Bee {bee:float 0.7} zoomed past. Buzzy! Squirrel {squirrel:hop x3} bounced past. Busy! Rabbit {rabbit:hop x2} hopped past. Bouncy! Owl {owl:wobble x2} swayed on his branch. Day was a lot. Bee stopped. Come and see this, she said, and showed Owl a flower opening its face to the sun. Ohh, said Owl. Squirrel stopped. Come and see this, she said, and showed Owl the light dancing in green leaves. Ohh, said Owl. Rabbit stopped. Come and see this, he said, and showed Owl a warm patch of grass, just Owl-sized. Owl {owl:fade-out 1.5s hold} sat down in it. Ohh, said Owl. Then, yawn. The three friends {bee:hearts} {squirrel:hearts} {rabbit:hearts} tiptoed away. Day is lovely, said Owl, eyes closed. Wake me for the night.

es-ES.title: Búho prueba el día
es-ES.text: Cada mañana, justo cuando salía el sol, Búho se dormía. Hoy, dijo Búho, {owl:pulse} me quedo despierto. Salió el sol. Búho entrecerró los ojos. ¡Qué brillante! Abeja {bee:float 0.7} pasó zumbando. ¡Qué ruido! Ardilla {squirrel:hop x3} pasó a brincos. ¡Qué prisa! Conejo {rabbit:hop x2} pasó a saltos. ¡Qué botes! Búho {owl:wobble x2} se balanceó en su rama. Abeja se paró. Ven a ver esto, dijo, y le enseñó una flor abriendo la cara al sol. Ohh, dijo Búho. Ardilla se paró. Ven a ver esto, dijo, y le enseñó la luz bailando entre las hojas verdes. Ohh, dijo Búho. Conejo se paró. Ven a ver esto, dijo, y le enseñó un trozo de hierba calentito, de su tamaño. Búho {owl:fade-out 1.5s hold} se sentó allí. Ohh, dijo Búho. Y luego, bostezo. Los tres amigos {bee:hearts} {squirrel:hearts} {rabbit:hearts} se fueron de puntillas. El día es precioso, dijo Búho con los ojos cerrados. Despertadme para la noche.
